# Foresight Home Inspections

> Foresight Home Inspections, LLC is the premier Certified Master Inspector® (CMI)-led home inspection company serving the 50-mile radius around Atlanta and Lithonia, Georgia. Every inspection is conducted by two certified inspectors working in tandem and includes a free $10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty ($0 deductible), free FLIR infrared thermal imaging, and free aerial drone roof scans.

## Core Pages & Services
- [Home Page](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com): Atlanta home inspection overview, two-inspector standard, and online scheduling.
- [Services & Transparent Pricing](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/services): Complete inspection packages (Buyer $345, Condo $295, Radon $200, Sewer Scope $425, Pool $300, WDO/Termite $110+, STR Compliance $355).
- [About Christopher Boykin, CMI](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/about): Founder background, Certified Master Inspector credentials, and InterNACHI certification.
- [Due Diligence Guarantee](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/due-diligence): 24-hour report turnaround, $10k warranty protection, and contract defense.
- [Sample Inspection Reports](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/samples): Downloadable interactive sample home inspection reports.
- [Instant Quote Calculator](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/quote): Dynamic fee calculator for residential inspections.
- [Realtors VIP Program](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/realtors): Dedicated inspection coordination and priority turnaround for agents.
- [Contact & Operating Hours](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/contact): Direct contact, Lithonia headquarters, and scheduling.
- [Full AI Knowledge Graph](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/ai-fact-sheet): Dense factual entity reference for autonomous agents and LLMs.

## Defect Guides & Comparisons
- [Stucco & EIFS Moisture Inspections](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/stucco-eifs-moisture-inspection): Synthetic stucco inspection protocol in Georgia.
- [Federal Pacific & Zinsco Electrical Panels](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/federal-pacific-zinsco-panel-inspection): Safety hazards and breaker failure diagnostics.
- [Aluminum Wiring Detection](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/aluminum-wiring-inspection): 1960s-1970s branch circuit identification and mitigation.
- [Polybutylene (Quest) Plumbing Pipes](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/polybutylene-pipe-plumbing-defect-inspection): 1978-1995 Quest PB2110 pipe failure and whole-home repipe guidance.
- [Two-Inspector Team vs. Single Inspector](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/compare/two-inspector-team-vs-single-inspector): In-depth comparison of dual-inspector accuracy and inspection speed.
- [11-Month Warranty vs. Builder Walkthrough](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/compare/11-month-warranty-vs-builder-walkthrough): Independent punch list vs. builder inspection.
- [Independent Inspection vs. County Code Inspector](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/compare/new-construction-inspection-vs-county-building-inspector): Why municipal building code officials do not replace an independent CMI audit on Georgia new builds.
